ops.body:
yasyf box pre-repair sweep results (2026-07-25) — recipe deltas + operational notes for the gated repair lane:

**State now**: recipe step 1 (kickstart serve) executed. The zombie 0.21.0 serve image is permanently gone (it was executing an unlinked inode — the 0.21.0 keg no longer exists on disk, so there was never a rollback path). Handshake-failure counter frozen at 20,471 (was ~8/min). But installed synckitd 0.35.2 cannot start: serve is in a launchd-throttled crash loop (`runs=35`, exit 1, ~2 MB/day log — deliberately left as-is until the gated pass).

**TWO schema blockers, not one** (repair must fix both):
1. `~/.config/synckit/manifests/{cc-pool,reposync}.json` — carry `watch.backend: "fsnotify"` (0.35.2 strict-decode rejects) AND stale `serve_args: ["rpc-serve"]`. Regeneration via `reposync install` / `cc-pool sync enable` (post-upgrade) must produce both fixes.
2. `state.json` — reconcile fails every 15-min spawn with `envelope: keys do not exactly match [schema host_registry synckit]`. **0.35.2 has never successfully run on this box** — the "reconcile runs 0.35.2" framing in note d0d443d0 was only true of the spawn, never a healthy run. `synckitd host add` state migration handles this (preserve peer yasyf@yasyf-home).

**Debris**: wedged daemonkit-worker and hung ugreps GONE (no reboot since Jul 19 — they exited/were reaped some other way). NEW: leaked daemonkit Go-test processes found (2× verifier-child orphaned 1d20h; sleep-0.01 busy-wait loops burning ~14% of a core) — evidence being captured, then killed (authorized). 12 Claude sessions untouched. 

**Operational for the repair lane**:
- Use LAN IP **192.168.4.28** — Tailscale name 100% loss; hostname SSH dropped 3× mid-sweep. WiFi stack is degraded (airportd 64% CPU, WiFiAgent 35% since Jul 19 boot; 220–600ms LAN ping) — separate issue, report-only, a user-approved reboot would likely clear it but the 12 Claude sessions must be reviewed first.
- serve log timestamps are ~19h ahead of wall clock (TZ/clock themselves correct) — verify by count sampling, never timestamp filtering.
- Brew inventory: synckitd 0.35.2, reposync 0.27.3, cc-pool 0.61.7 (HEAD-06621a7), captain-hook 12.20.2, cc-notes 0.47.2, cc-orchestrate 0.5.1, cc-patch 0.11.1, fusekit-holder 1.5.0; no cc-interact, no daemonkit formula. Stray GOBIN synckitd + six swarm artifacts confirmed at ~/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.26.5/bin/ (hygiene step 6).
